widget.heading: Ship plan: Space Events Digest (4–6 weeks)
widget.description: A practical roadmap to implement an automated космонавтика digest: data sources, normalization, summarization, and a mobile-first feed with calendar export.

steps.name: Source discovery & schema
steps.detail: Identify 2–3 reliable sources (official agency pages, launch schedule sites, RSS/Atom feeds). Define a normalized event schema: mission_name, provider, vehicle, window_start, window_end, location, liv

steps.name: Ingestion pipeline
steps.detail: Implement fetchers with retries, rate limiting, and HTML-to-structured extraction where needed. Store raw payloads for traceability. Schedule daily runs and emit structured events into a database.

steps.name: Deduplication & quality rules
steps.detail: Add canonicalization (time rounding, name normalization), fuzzy matching for mission names, and conflict resolution (prefer official sources). Flag uncertain fields and track provenance per attribute.

steps.name: Summaries & localization

steps.name: Mobile-first UI + calendar export
steps.detail: Build a feed with filters (This week / This month / By provider) and an event detail view. Add ICS export and deep links to livestreams. Implement caching and skeleton loading for slow networks.
